home.title: Think you know football? Prove it.
home.description: From player guessing and career paths to daily faceoffs and Survivor brackets, put your football knowledge to the test. Earn LP, climb the ranks and beat your friends.
home.gamesSubtitle: Play solo, challenge friends or join the daily football debates.
home.featuresSubtitle: Your FootBattle account keeps progression, competition and friends in one place.

games.title: Guess the Player
games.description: Use the clues and identify the footballer in as few guesses as possible.

games.title: Career Path
games.description: Complete a footballer's career by finding the clubs they represented.

games.title: Daily Faceoff
games.description: Two footballers, one choice. See which side the community takes.

games.title: Football Survivor
games.description: Pick your champion from a 16-player or 16-team bracket.

games.title: Football Tic Tac Toe
games.description: Find the right player for each club and country intersection.

games.title: Football Wordle
games.description: Narrow down the hidden footballer guess by guess.

features.title: Competitive Ranks
features.description: Earn LP from Bronze III all the way to GOAT and climb the seasonal leaderboard.

features.title: Friend Rivalries
features.description: Add friends, overtake them in LP and grow your crew with invite links.

features.title: Shareable Results
features.description: Share scores, Survivor champions and faceoff picks in a single tap.

home.finalDescription: Play for free, build your profile and prove your football knowledge through the ranks.
